translations.web: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
translations.bsb: He who walks in integrity walks securely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
translations.kjv: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
translations.asv: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely; But he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
